scenes.visual: Frame 0 is already full: a cream meeting card reading 'Next meeting · Creandum'. A red line snaps from it to a 'Lovable' node at 1.2 s; the verdict chip 'Backed Lovable · Feb 2025' stamps in at 2.2 s with a hard thud. Burned-in captions from frame 0 for muted autoplay.

lines.text: Your next investor meeting already backed your competitor. They just want to hear your pitch.

scenes.visual: Dark. Deck pages, a customer list and a roadmap slide travel along the red line out of the founder's card, one by one, into the competitor node.

lines.text: At Slush, founders pitch back to back. Nobody checks who's across the table. Your deck can walk straight to a rival.

scenes.visual: Full-bleed FlipDD red. The FlipDD mark turns over (the flip) and the wordmark lands. Tagline in big kinetic type, accent word 'back' in italic serif.

lines.text: FlipDD flips the due diligence. Check your investors back, before you send the deck.
lines.say: Flip-D-D flips the due diligence. Check your investors back, before you send the deck.

scenes.visual: Live footage of /app recorded 14 Nov 2026 14:04 UTC: Load example, Ask Cala live ticked, Check; the live scan board fills; header reads 90 live, cache off, 8.0 s.

lines.text: Paste your meeting list and your competitors. FlipDD walks the Cala graph live. Ninety calls, in eight seconds.
lines.say: Paste your meeting list and your competitors. Flip-D-D walks the Kahla graph live. Ninety calls, in eight seconds.

scenes.visual: Camera moves across the real rows. Each tie lights as it is named: Creandum row (Direct, red), Northzone row with the path Northzone to Accel to Lovable drawn on the motif line, Atomico row (lookalike: Framer), then a Person finding chip.

lines.text: It finds four kinds of tie. A direct stake: Creandum backed Lovable. One step away: Northzone co-invests with Accel, Lovable's lead. A lookalike. And a partner on a rival's board.

scenes.visual: Footage zooms into the round panel. '4 of your 8 meetings are within one step of Lovable' types on; the score counts to 41/100; the suggested meeting order slides in, safest first.

lines.text: Then it reads your whole round. Four of eight meetings sit one step from Lovable. Meet the safest first.

scenes.visual: Find investors tab footage: 58 considered counts down to 6 clean cards; the 8 dropped ones fall away in red.

lines.text: It finds the clean ones too. Six funds near your market, with no tie to your rivals.

scenes.visual: Light. The call mark rings. Phone screen: the real call (owner's screen recording if available). Caller and FlipDD bubbles appear word-synced. Then quick cuts: a Telegram voice note getting a voice reply, and Play my day in the app.

lines.text: I'm meeting Creandum and Northzone. My competitor is Lovable.
Creandum: direct conflict. Backed Lovable, February 2025. Teaser only.
Or use Telegram. Or press Play my day.

scenes.visual: Dark. The Cala logo; a source link on a finding opens. One line: 'Every fact from Cala. Every finding sourced.'

lines.text: Every fact comes from Cala, with its source.
lines.say: Every fact comes from Kahla, with its source.

scenes.visual: Full-bleed red, the FlipDD logo, the live URL, 'Built on Cala · Junction 2026'. Optional 3 s founder cameo just before the logo.

lines.text: FlipDD. Know who is across the table.
lines.say: Flip-D-D. Know who is across the table.
